name: Customer Support Chatbot
description: Customer-facing chatbot that answers billing questions using customers' names, email addresses, and account balances. Powered by a third-party LLM API.
documentation: Conversation transcripts are retained for 12 months and then deleted. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. The vendor is documented under a signed data processing agreement. Customers are told that they are chatting with an AI assistant and can ask for a human agent at any time.
